name: stack-hub
description: A semantic layer over the best open-source agentic skills. Concept-level skills synthesised from several upstream stacks and ported to run in Claude Code.

plugins.name: stack-hub-core
plugins.description: Semantic skills that have earned their place: each one survived at least three real uses in lab and replaced the upstream plugin it supersedes.

plugins.name: stack-hub-lab
plugins.description: Semantic skills on probation. Install alongside the upstream plugins they draw on, so you can compare them on real work before promoting.
